page.overview:
Who is Ngyr-Khorath?

Ngyr-Khorath (also known as The Ultimate Abomination, The Dream-Death, and The Mad God of the Void, among other titles) is an entity featured in the Mlandoth Cycle by Walter C. DeBill Jr. It has existed in the area now home to the Solar System since before the Sun and planets formed. It appears as a red or deep blue-green mist which causes a sense of terror as it approaches. Once close, an eye of flame forms within. When life arrived on Earth, it became enraged. A cult to Ngyr-Khorath exists. Its legend (part of the so-called Mlandoth Cycle) appears in the Book of Thoth, The Chronicles of Thrang, the Uralte Schrecken, and The Texts of Mloeng. Von Könnenberg suggests that it is a form of the entity Mlandoth, and itself has an avatar, 'Ymnar.

It spawned by fission the Great Old One (or its avatar) 'Ymnar, and its nemesis is the Elder God Paighon.
